description: A PostHog SQL (insight) variable: a named, typed value that SQL insights reference as {variables.code_name}.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the SQL variable belongs to.

Name.description: Human-readable name of the variable. PostHog derives CodeName from it.

Type.description: Variable type. Controls how the value is rendered and substituted in HogQL: `String`, `Number`, `Boolean`, `List` or `Date`.

DefaultValue.description: Default value used when a query references the variable. A plain string for String, Date and single-value List variables; a number such as "42" for Number; "true" or "false" for Boolean; a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString) for multi-value List variables.

IsMulti.description: Whether a List variable accepts multiple selected values.

ValuesQuery.description: HogQL query whose first result column supplies the allowed values of a List variable. An optional second column supplies display labels.

ValuesQueryConnectionId.description: ID of the external data source connection ValuesQuery runs against. Leave unset to run it against PostHog.

CodeName.description: Code-safe name used in HogQL as {variables.code_name}. Derived from Name.
